questions.explain: The chapter says the tipping point where the optimizer abandons seek-plus-key-lookup for a straight scan is exactly what covering indexes and INCLUDE columns exist to move in your favor.

More memory grants
Filtered statistics

options: Online builds are free of any locking
Online index builds are only available in Express Edition
ONLINE = ON (Enterprise) lets reads and writes continue during the build, but it takes longer, uses more tempdb, and needs brief locks at start and end
Resumable builds require the SIMPLE recovery model

questions.explain: The chapter says NEWID() produces random UUIDs that scatter inserts and fragment relentlessly; the practical fixes are an IDENTITY surrogate key, NEWSEQUENTIALID() for the clustered key, or aggressive rebuilds with lower fill factor.
options: Use BIGINT instead of UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
Disable page splits
Use an IDENTITY surrogate key, NEWSEQUENTIALID() for the clustered key, or aggressive rebuilds with a lower fill factor
Set fill factor to 100
